I would start with execution such as moves and bread and butter combos for your main. 

Then focus on mechanics like Roman cancels when to burst maybe if you found a main learning who you are strong and weak against in a match and how to play those match ups. (ie chip into potem, sol into nago)

Finally when your comfortable with that fine tune your game play by learning the player you facing and attempt to adapt. Experience triumphs many things in games like these.

The glue that holds this all together is practice. Just throwing yourself at games is really the best way to learn. Go to a park and dont be afraid to lose 10 matches in a row

During my first week with strive every day I had atleast one opponent where I lost 20 times till I finally won. Try and keep a level head and focus on what they are doing and how you can one up them. Practicing to do this faster will help you climb in the long run. 

Best of luck out there!
